changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'MapRuleItemMapRule') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[MapRuleItemMapRule]( [MapRuleID] [int] NOT NULL, [MapRuleItemID] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MapRuleItemMapRule] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [MapRuleID] ASC, [MapRuleItemID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MapRuleItemMap_MapRule') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[MapRuleItemMapRule] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MapRuleItemMap_MapRule] FOREIGN KEY([MapRuleID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[MapRule] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[MapRuleItemMapRule] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MapRuleItemMap_MapRule] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MapRuleItemMap_MapRuleItem') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[MapRuleItemMapRule] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MapRuleItemMap_MapRuleItem] FOREIGN KEY([MapRuleItemID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[MapRuleItem] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[MapRuleItemMapRule] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MapRuleItemMap_MapRuleItem] END
